managedGuestAdaptations.reason: Electron otherwise exposes an empty child frame tree and deadlocks OOPIF input.

managedGuestAdaptations.reason: An empty accessibility subtree has no upstream aria-ref; a positional nth selector could drift to a different editor after frame reordering.
managedGuestAdaptations.isolation: The token retains an exact ElementHandle in Main and is bound to run, activation, surface generation, and a 60-second TTL; it is consumed once and never persisted as a CDP or DOM identity.
